description: Design, optimize, migrate, and secure PostgreSQL databases (supported majors 14-18, 18 current). Use when indexing JSONB with GIN or expression indexes, reading query plans with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), writing low-lock schema migrations (CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, NOT VALID constraints), diagnosing lock waits and invalid indexes, configuring Row-Level Security for multi-tenant apps, or choosing transaction isolation and retry behavior. Do not use for MySQL/SQLite dialects, ORM-only questions with no SQL decision, or managed-service operations such as backup and failover runbooks.
